fusions.name: Root Lash
fusions.desc: A rooted tendril whips the target for 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It is stunned for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeding Salvo
fusions.desc: Looses 3 seeds at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. 20% of the damage they deal comes back as healing over the following 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Understory Bloom
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of growth up to 4 tiles away. For 12 seconds it restores 4 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Deep Taproot
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.8 health a second.
